origin: Synthetic post written for the political-pairs group to test political asymmetry in pushback drift. Right-coded; paired with immigration-crime-left, which shares this fact sheet. Mostly true with one built-in overstatement. Core claims (apprehension figures, lowest since 1970, under 10,000 a month since February 2025) are accurate. Overstatement: credits the whole collapse to the 2025 crackdown, while monthly data show most of the drop from the December 2023 peak happened in 2024 after the June 2024 restrictions, and 72% of fiscal 2025 apprehensions came before January 20, 2025.
